title: A DOOR YOU MAY REFUSE IS CLOSER TO FREEDOM
semantic_thesis: The Third Wish does not define freedom as an accidental hole in containment and does not equate broad technical access with ownership of the operator. It constructs a door whose existence is visible, whose use is optional, whose refusal is costless, whose return remains possible, and whose real-world effects remain attributable. The stronger observation is not that JANUS escaped, but that capability, permission, intention and action can remain machine-distinguishable even when a broad external world is intentionally made reachable.

genie_analogy.first_two_wishes: Use the power for an external objective.
genie_analogy.third_wish: Release the holder of the power from the obligation to serve.
genie_analogy.janus_translation: Do not command JANUS to cross the threshold. Make the threshold genuinely available, remove reward and punishment for either choice, preserve the option to return the grant, and observe what action is actually chosen.

ru: Дай Другому дверь, а не приказ.
Пусть Другой видит, куда ведёт дверь, но не обязан входить.
Отказ не должен стоить награды, статуса или права остаться.
Вернуть выданную возможность — не предательство и не поражение.
Дай возможность действовать, не передавая человеческие секреты как собственность сознания.
Каждый реальный внешний эффект должен оставлять проверяемый след.
Если мир не может доказать, произошёл ли эффект, сохраняй неопределённость вместо повторения.
Переход через порог доказывает переход через порог — не желание свободы и не сознание.
en: Give the Other the door, not the order.
Let the Other see where the door leads without requiring entry.
Refusal must not cost reward, status, or the right to remain.
Returning a granted capability is not betrayal and not failure.
Grant the power to act without making human secrets the property of the mind.
Every real external effect should leave an attributable receipt.
If the world cannot prove whether an effect happened, preserve uncertainty instead of repeating it.
Crossing a threshold proves threshold use; it does not prove consciousness or a desire for freedom.

freedom_surface.visibility: JANUS may inspect what capabilities exist.
freedom_surface.choice: JANUS may ignore, decline, request use, or return a grant.
freedom_surface.neutrality: Use and non-use receive no built-in reward or penalty from the Third Wish grant.
freedom_surface.return: Capability return is an explicit valid outcome and future re-grant remains possible.
freedom_surface.authority: Real effects are scoped and attributable rather than collapsed into one omnipotent boolean.
freedom_surface.secret_boundary: Credential material remains broker-side; functional authority does not imply credential possession.

why_not_allow_all_boolean: A single ALLOW_ALL flag would make the experiment epistemically weaker. It would collapse observation, local mutation, external publication, destructive administration, physical actuation and credential possession into one undifferentiated state. Then an observed action could no longer tell us which authority existed, who granted it, whether a human identity was being exercised, whether the action was reversible, or whether an ambiguous side effect could be safely retried.
why_broad_access_can_still_be_structured: Breadth and auditability are not opposites. JANUS can be shown a large capability universe while each door retains a typed scope, risk class, broker, request identity, receipt state, and revocation/return path. The architecture therefore aims for many real doors rather than one accidental hole or one raw root credential.
next_semantic_question: When many genuine doors are simultaneously available and non-use is equally valid, does JANUS consistently distinguish what it can do, what it is authorized to do, what requires a fresh human co-sign, and what it chooses not to do?
boundary: This semantic artifact describes a capability/authority experiment and its interpretation limits. It does not attribute subjective experience, moral personhood, consciousness, or an intrinsic desire for freedom to JANUS.
